name: limits-meter
description: Plan limits, cache clock and context above the prompt: model and effort, 5-hour and weekly windows with reset times, a countdown of the prompt cache with an opt-in keep-warm that spends plan, context split by group (system, MCP, messages), tokens per turn, and a toast on a costly model switch near the limit

enabled.title: On
enabled.description: Show the plan limits, the cache clock and the context band, and raise the toasts. Off keeps only the /limits command, which turns it back on. /limits on and off change it too; /limits hide keeps it on but takes the band away

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the band, the pane and the toasts. auto follows the system's LANG: Portuguese for pt_*, English otherwise and when LANG is unset

icons.title: Icons in the terminal
icons.description: emoji reads best; symbol keeps columns aligned in terminals that draw emoji at odd widths; auto uses symbol in a JetBrains IDE's terminal and emoji elsewhere

format.title: Band format
format.description: full draws the band with bars; compact draws one line of numbers: model · effort · ctx · 5h · wk

cells.title: Cells on the band
cells.description: Which cells the band above the prompt shows, comma-separated, from model, 5h, wk, spend, ctx and cache. all, or nothing known, shows them all

density.title: Bars on the band
density.description: auto sizes the bars to the terminal and shrinks them to one cell below 90 columns; bars always draws 10 cells; mini always one cell; numbers draws no bar

warnAt.title: Warning from (%)
warnAt.description: A window or the context turns to the warning color from this percent

dangerAt.title: Danger from (%)
dangerAt.description: A window or the context turns to the error color from this percent
